g.text: Reword a document and one number moves. Shuffle it and the other one does. That separation is the point.
Two independent questions need two independent numbers.
If both numbers always moved together they would be measuring the same thing, and neither could tell you which kind of change happened.
In each pair, cyan marks changed wording and orange marks a changed position • each gauge runs from 0 on the left (identical) to far apart on the right
